description: This is a shell script for orchestrating end-to-end tests across multiple virtual machines and hosting environments. It sets up VM configurations, manages updates for macOS, Windows, and Linux guests, runs smoke tests for initial package baselines, performs self-updates, and generates a JSON summary with the test results.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Prints a message with a prefix '==>' to standard output.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Prints a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Prints an error message to standard error and exits the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Kills the server process if running and removes temporary directories, set to execute on script exit.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script options.

methods.name: resolve_linux_vm_name
methods.description: Determines the best matching Linux VM name based on requested version, using adjustments for Ubuntu versions.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Retrieves the latest published version of 'openclaw' from npm registry.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Detects the host machine's IP address in the 10.211.* subnet.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Finds an available TCP port on the host machine for serving files.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Builds the current branch of the project using 'pnpm build'.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tarball of the current Git HEAD for deployment.

methods.name: write_windows_update_script
methods.description: Generates a PowerShell script used for updating Windows guests.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a simple HTTP server to serve the build artifacts.

methods.name: wait_job
methods.description: Waits for a background process to complete and checks its exit status.

methods.name: extract_log_progress
methods.description: Extracts current progress information from a log file.

methods.name: dump_log_tail
methods.description: Outputs the last lines of a log file to assist debugging.

methods.name: monitor_jobs_progress
methods.description: Displays real-time progress of multiple background jobs by monitoring log outputs.

methods.name: extract_last_version
methods.description: Parses the latest version string from a log file based on regex patterns.

methods.name: guest_powershell
methods.description: Executes an encoded PowerShell script inside a Windows VM.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout, capturing output and signaling timeout with specific exit code.

methods.name: guest_powershell_poll
methods.description: Repeatedly executes PowerShell commands inside Windows VM with timeout handling.

methods.name: run_windows_script_via_log
methods.description: Manages Windows guest scripts execution with log streaming and progress monitoring.

methods.name: run_macos_update
methods.description: Performs update steps inside a macOS VM, including installation and version verification.

methods.name: run_windows_update
methods.description: Performs Windows guest update process via the generated script and log collection.

methods.name: run_linux_update
methods.description: Performs Linux guest update steps, including package installation and version verification.

methods.name: write_summary_json
methods.description: Generates a JSON report summarizing the test run results and statuses.
